content.title: Parker Hannifin BV-BR-025 Brass Ball Valve, 0.25 in, 600 psi
content.short_description: Parker Hannifin BV-BR-025 is a 0.25 in brass ball valve rated for 600 psi, used for on/off flow control in fluid handling systems.
content.long_description:
The Parker Hannifin BV-BR-025 is a ball-type valve constructed with a brass body, sized at 0.25 in nominal. It carries a pressure rating of 600 psi, suitable for fluid handling lines operating within this pressure range.

As a ball valve, the BV-BR-025 provides on/off flow control via a rotating ball with a bored passage, allowing quarter-turn operation between open and closed positions. The brass body construction is applicable for a range of fluid handling applications where this material is compatible with the media and environment.

Confirm line size, pressure requirements, and media compatibility with brass before installation. This valve falls under the Industrial Valves category within Fluid Handling components.
